title: Musculoskeletal pain / injury
note: DRAFT clinical content for CMO / Nursing Head review – not for clinical use until approved

questions.text: Obvious deformity, loss of pulse, or numbness / weakness below the injury?
Back pain with loss of bladder/bowel control or saddle numbness?

EMERGENCY.disposition: Call emergency services / airside medical response now; do not leave the employee alone

URGENT.disposition: Same-day review by OH physician; consider temporary unfitness for safety-critical duties

SEMI_URGENT.disposition: OH nurse assessment within 4 hours; consider modified duties

ROUTINE.disposition: OH nurse appointment within 1 working day; self-care advice

ADVICE.disposition: Self-care advice and portal follow-up; no appointment required
